about.text: Our Story
Redefining gaming excellence through innovation and precision engineering
Born from Passion, Built for Champions
Founded in 2018 by a team of professional gamers and engineers, NEXUS GEAR was born from a simple idea: create gaming equipment that doesn't compromise on performance, durability, or design.
We noticed that most gaming gear either focused on flashy aesthetics or basic functionality, but rarely both. Our mission was to bridge this gap and create products that look as good as they perform.
"Every gamer deserves equipment that elevates their game, not limits it." - Marcus Chen, Founder
Our Philosophy
Innovation First
We invest heavily in R&D to bring cutting-edge technology to every product, ensuring you always have the competitive edge.
Uncompromising Quality
Every component is tested to withstand millions of cycles. We don't cut corners on materials or manufacturing.
Community Driven
We work directly with pro gamers and our community to refine our products based on real feedback and needs.
Our Mission
To empower gamers worldwide with precision-engineered gear that delivers professional-grade performance, exceptional durability, and stunning aesthetics—all at an accessible price point.
The Art of Engineering
Every NEXUS GEAR product begins with meticulous research and prototyping. Our engineers work alongside professional esports athletes to understand exactly what top-tier performance demands.

We use only premium materials—from aerospace-grade aluminum frames to durable mechanical switches rated for 80 million keystrokes. Each product undergoes rigorous testing before it reaches your hands.
Our Journey
Meet the Team
Our Commitment
We're dedicated to pushing the boundaries of gaming technology while maintaining environmental responsibility and ethical manufacturing practices.

We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Orders typically ship within 1-2 business days. Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days within the US. Express shipping (2-3 business days) is available for an additional fee. International shipping times vary by location.

We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused products in their original packaging. If you're not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return it for a full refund or exchange. Returns are free for domestic orders. Please contact our support team to initiate a return.

Yes, we ship worldwide! International shipping rates vary by destination and are calculated at checkout. Delivery times typically range from 7-21 business days depending on location. Please note that customers are responsible for any customs duties or taxes that may apply.

All NEXUS GEAR products come with a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. If your product has any defects within the warranty period, we'll repair or replace it free of charge. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, accidents, or normal wear and tear.
How do I track my order?

Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also track your order by logging into your account and viewing your order history. If you have any issues with tracking, please contact our support team for assistance.
